messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected for /v1/complete on inference-gateway. Trigger: 5xx > 10% for 3m. Paging oncall.

ana: ack - grabbing metrics and recent control-plane diffs.

josh: I'm in. Any recent route or envoy config changes?

priya: saw a config push ~02:07 UTC that changed retry policy on /v1/complete to num_retries=5 and enabled retry_on: gateway-error. Also bump to cluster_max_pending=1024 in CB.

ben: confirmed spike shows sharp increase from baseline 0.2% -> 12% 5xx between 02:08-02:12 UTC. p95 latency doubled.

oncall-bot: @oncall-engineer paged for incidents channel.

ana: hypothesis: over-aggressive retries + raised pending limit causing head-of-line blocking and amplified failures. We'll need to revert or mitigate quickly.

josh: can we shadow traffic to pool-c or divert with header-based routing? We have a healthy pool-c in the same region.

priya: quick mitigation plan: (1) disable gateway retries for this route, (2) set weights to divert 70% to pool-c, (3) lower cluster_max_pending to a safe value to let requests fail fast.

ben: applying weight change now via control-plane:
```
POST /api/v1/routes/modify
{"route":"/v1/complete","weights":{"pool-a":0.0,"pool-b":0.3,"pool-c":0.7}}
```

ops-bot: config-change recorded: change_id=chg-20260315-0209, triggered by ben. Propagating to edge proxies.

josh: disabling retries on gateway:
```
kubectl -n gateway exec gateway-ctrl -- sh -c 'edgenetctl update-route --name complete --retries 0'
```

priya: patching envoy CB to reduce pending limit:
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-cb --patch '{"data":{"cluster_max_pending":"300"}}'
```

ana: monitoring panels now. 5xx trending down to ~4% in next 45s after weight diversion. Good signal.

ben: pool-a still emits errors as it's actively draining; pool-b healthy but lower capacity. pool-c carrying new load well.

josh: running a quick log grep - found many "upstream overloaded" and "overrun pending requests" from envoy: 
```
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=edge-proxy --since=10m | egrep "upstream overloaded|overrun pending" | head -n 30
```

priya: found manual config push by deploy-bot: deploy-2026-03-15T02:06:45 which included CB/Retry deltas. Looks like a canary change that accidentally rolled further than intended.

ana: immediate action - roll the canary back and add an automated guard to stop canary promotion if 5xx increases. ben can you trigger rollback?

ben: initiating rollback to previous route config:
```
controlplane rollback --change chg-20260315-0206
```

ops-bot: rollback started: chg-20260315-0206 -> target state pre-02:06.

ana: after rollback + weight shift + retries off, 5xx down to ~0.7% within 2m. Still monitoring for residual timeouts.

oncall-bot: Handoff in 20m to day-shift. New oncall: josh.

ben: customer-impact: approx 0.35% of live requests got 5xx or timeouts during the peak window. I'll coordinate with cs-bot for status update.

cs-bot: Posted status: "Partial and transient degradation of /v1/complete; mitigations applied. Affected customers may have seen higher error rates between 02:08-02:13 UTC."

josh: root-cause notes so far: canary config promoted retry_on + high num_retries + increased pending limits -> retry amplification under a transient capacity dip (pool-a had 3 pods restarted by kube due to liveness flaps) -> head-of-line blocking at envoy -> increased 5xx.

priya: follow-ups I'll take: (1) lock down canary promotion logic - require 15m steady-state before auto-promote, (2) lower default num_retries to 1 and make retry_on opt-in per service, (3) add a health-check ramp to prevent autoscaler from scaling down too aggressively when probes fail.

ben: infra tasks: (1) add guard in control-plane to block weight promotion if p95 latency increases by >30%, (2) add a rate-limited rollback trigger to auto-revert risky route edits.

ana: ops-runbook updates: include explicit CB tuning steps and a checklist to disable retries during early remediation.

josh: logging/trace follow-up: capture full envoy traces for the time window and attach to incident story. I'll own that.

priya: scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Priya (owner), Ben (control-plane), Josh (oncall) to present.

ana: mitigation complete :white_check_mark:. Closing active pager alerts. Incident remains open for postmortem and follow-ups.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0315-3480001111. Actions and diffs uploaded to infra/incidents/3480001111/.

josh: thanks team. Keep channel updated with any anomalies during the 1h observation window.

end of thread - please consolidate notes into the incident tracker and link runbook edits.
